name: lifecycle-evidence-reminder
description: Advisory-only (never blocks) reminder printed when a commit changes a skill's SKILL.md or references/ without also touching that skill's lifecycle.json. Not a strict pairing rule -- whether a given change actually needs a lifecycle.json update is a judgment call the script cannot make -- but it catches the exact real gap found in this repository's own PR #72 (substantive content shipped with zero lifecycle.json change). Assumes cloudbox-skills' own `.agents/skills/<name>/` repository layout; not intended for installation outside this repository.
